articles.meta: 第一作者: Liantao Song · 方向: 软件安全
articles.summary: 该研究针对现有基于微虚拟机的机密容器架构存在资源开销大、启动延迟高的问题。作者提出了一个基于ARM机密计算架构的轻量级机密容器运行时Fasco，它通过直接将每个容器实例化为一个独立的受保护域来确保数据机密性与完整性，旨在降低资源占用并提升短生命周期容器的适用性。

articles.title: Building an Adversarial Malware Dataset by Family and Type: Generation, Evasion, and Poisoning Evaluation
articles.excerpt: Abstract:We present a dataset of adversarial malware samples derived from the public RawMal-TF collection of real-world malware binaries. Using a suite of adversarial malware generators, we construct two sets of adversarial PE files: 44,347 family-labelled samples and 33,596 type-labelled samples, achieving evasion rates of 98.35 % and 92.20 % against the EMBER classifier, respectively. Each adversarial binary is accompanied by detailed metadata, including EMBER scores and VirusTotal classifications. We further demonstrate the susceptibility of malware classification pipelines to data poisoning attacks through a series of training experiments. Injecting fully mislabelled adversarial samples representing only 0.5 % of the training data in the family-labelled dataset increases the evasion rate against the re-trained classifier from 26.1 % to 92.8 %. The dataset is publicly released to...
articles.meta: 第一作者: David Košťál · 方向: 软件安全
articles.summary: 本文构建并发布了一个公开的对抗性恶意软件数据集，包含按家族和类型标签分类的对抗性样本。研究显示，这些样本能高概率规避EMBER分类器的检测。此外，实验验证了向训练数据中注入少量完全误标样本即可严重影响分类器性能，表明机器学习恶意软件分类流程易受数据投毒攻击。

articles.title: Semantic Validation of Packer Identification Tools: Characterization, Repair, and Downstream Impact
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Packer identification tools are a critical foundation of malware analysis, directly affecting unpacking, behavioral analysis, malware classification, and threat attribution. However, their semantic correctness is rarely validated. In practice, a tool may return a plausible packer label that is nevertheless semantically wrong, leading to failed unpacking and unreliable downstream analysis. This paper presents a semantic validation framework for testing and repairing packer identification tools. Our key idea is to use unpackers as executable semantic contracts. If a tool predicts a packer family, the corresponding unpacker should recover analyzable program content. This enables automatic test oracles without requiring manually labeled ground truth. articles.meta: 第一作者: Fangtian Zhong · 方向: 软件安全
articles.summary: 打包器识别工具是恶意软件分析的关键基础，但其语义正确性常被忽视。本文提出一个语义验证框架，其核心是将解包器作为可执行的语义契约，用以自动检测、定位和修复现有打包识别工具中的语义错误，从而提升后续解包、分类与威胁溯源的可靠性。

articles.title: Capability and Robustness Cannot Both Be Free: An Information-Theoretic Bound for Vision-Language-Action Models
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly deployed on real robots, where each predicted action is executed and each failure carries a safety cost. They reach high success rates on clean inputs but collapse under small adversarial perturbations. A $16/255$ PGD attack on OpenVLA-7B drops LIBERO success from above $95\%$ to under $5\%$. Empirical defenses recover some robustness at a cost in clean accuracy, but the literature does not say whether the trade-off has a theoretical floor. We prove that it does. For any VLA policy with discrete actions, the sum of capability (mutual information between policy action and oracle action) and robustness (mutual information preserved under adversarial perturbation, net of trivial channel leakage) is upper-bounded by a policy-independent budget: task entropy plus adversarial channel capacity. articles.meta: 第一作者: Jianwei Tai · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 随着视觉-语言-动作模型在真实机器人上的部署，其安全性至关重要。本文从信息论角度证明，对于离散动作的VLA策略，其能力与鲁棒性之和存在一个与策略无关的理论上界，该上界由任务熵和对抗信道容量决定，为理解其固有的安全-性能权衡提供了理论基础。

articles.title: Broken Object Level Authorization in the Wild: An Empirical Taxonomy from 100+ Bug Bounty Disclosures
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) is consistently ranked the most critical API security vulnerability, yet the existing literature remains almost entirely conceptual. This paper presents one of the first large-scale empirical analyses of BOLA in publicly disclosed bug bounty reports. We constructed a reproducible sampling frame of 200 HackerOne disclosures tagged IDOR or Improper Access Control (2021-2026) and applied a three-criterion inclusion filter, yielding 107 fully classified reports. Classification used an LLM-assisted schema-completion procedure under constrained, human-adjudicated criteria against a six-family BOLA taxonomy. Of 107 classified reports, 84 (78.5%) were confirmed in-scope BOLA. articles.meta: 第一作者: Bandana Kaur · 方向: 软件安全
articles.summary: 对象级授权破损是严重的API安全漏洞，但现有研究多停留在概念层面。本文基于100余份公开的漏洞赏金报告，进行了首次大规模经验分析，并构建了一个包含六个类别的BOLA分类法。分析发现，直接对象引用和操作级对象BOLA是常见的表现形式。

articles.title: Proof of Useful Attestation: A Consensus Primitive for Attestation-Native Chains
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Validators on generic Proof of Stake chains earn the same fees whether they handle attestation work correctly or selectively censor it. For chains whose main activity is moving tokens around, that indifference is fine. For chains whose primary economic activity is recording attestations (content provenance, AI-output attribution, threshold-signed credentials, supply-chain receipts), the indifference becomes a problem. Proof of Useful Attestation (PoUA) makes attestation handling first-class in the consensus weighting itself. Validator vote weight is the product of bonded stake and a reputation scalar in [r_min, r_max] that accumulates from valid attestation work. The reputation update is additive, fee-weighted, non-transferable, and capped per epoch. articles.meta: 第一作者: Stefan Stefanović · 方向: 区块链安全
articles.summary: 针对主要经济活动为记录认证的区块链，本文提出有用证明共识机制。该机制使验证者处理认证工作的表现直接影响其在共识中的投票权重，通过可累加、不可转让且带上限的声誉分数来激励正确行为，并分析了其防止刷分攻击的成本下限。

articles.title: TTPrint: Evidence-Grounded TTP Extraction via Diverge-then-Converge Verification
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Extracting MITRE ATT&CK techniques from cyber threat intelligence (CTI) reports is an open-set, multi-label problem requiring both high recall (not missing techniques) and high precision (not hallucinating unsupported ones). Existing methods--rule-based, supervised, and LLM-based--struggle to achieve both: rule-based and supervised approaches lack generalizability across diverse attack descriptions, while LLM-based approaches that couple candidate generation and validation within a single inference step suffer from limited recall and precision simultaneously. We propose TTPrint, which addresses this challenge through a diverge-then-converge design inspired by how human analysts work: first extracting broadly, then verifying rigorously. articles.meta: 第一作者: Yutong Cheng · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 从网络威胁情报报告中提取ATT&CK技术是一个需要高召回率和高精确率的开放集多标签问题。本文提出TTPrint方法，采用「先发散后收敛」的设计：先广泛提取候选技术，再通过确定性跨度验证进行严格筛选，以平衡召回率与精确率，优于现有耦合生成与验证的方法。

articles.title: "What is the Problem Space?" Defining Host-space Adversarial Perturbations against Network Intrusion Detection Systems
articles.excerpt: Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) are now increasingly leveraging Machine Learning (ML) techniques to detect malicious network activities. Numerous papers have scrutinized the security of ML-based NIDS (ML-NIDS) by testing them against various attacks involving adversarial perturbations. The findings were oftentimes worrying: by making imperceptible changes to a given input, powerful ML models would be bypassed. In this context, we took a step back and wondered: where (i.e., in what "space") have these perturbations been applied? We argue that real-world adversaries can apply adversarial perturbations only by operating on the hosts they can control -- a concept which we define as _host-space perturbations_. articles.meta: 第一作者: Miel Verkerken · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 本文审视了针对机器学习网络入侵检测系统的对抗性攻击研究，指出先前工作常在不现实的网络流量「空间」施加扰动。作者明确定义了「宿主空间扰动」概念，强调真实攻击者只能通过控制主机来实现扰动，并呼吁未来研究需基于此更实际的威胁模型进行评估。

articles.title: SAMark: A Self-Anchored Text Watermarking with Paragraph-Level Paraphrase Robustness
articles.excerpt: Semantic-level watermarking (SWM) improves robustness against text modifications by treating sentences as the basic unit. However, robustness to paragraph-level paraphrasing remains difficult because such attacks globally disrupt watermark signals by changing sentence order. In this work, we propose SAMark, a self-anchored watermarking framework that removes the dependency on sentence order by establishing a step-independent green region in semantic space. To improve detectability, we introduce a multi-channel hyperbolic scoring mechanism that amplifies watermark signals while suppressing noise from weakly aligned candidates. We further propose a diversity-aware filtering strategy that combines hard filtering with soft regularization, extending beyond simple n-gram repetition filters to address semantic redundancy. Experimental results show that SAMark achieves up to 90.2% TP@FP1%...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Jiahao Huo · 方向: 安全研究
articles.summary: 本文针对语义级文本水印在段落级改写攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出SAMark自锚定水印框架。该框架通过在语义空间建立步长无关绿区去除对句子顺序的依赖，引入多通道双曲评分机制以放大水印信号并抑制噪声，并采用多样性感知过滤策略应对语义冗余，提升了水印检测性能，可用于文本版权保护与内容溯源。

articles.title: Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Distribution Statistics Analytics on Mobile Spatial Data
articles.excerpt: Abstract:With the rapid development of mobile computing technology, massive amounts of spatial data are continuously generated from various mobile terminals and sensing devices, such as smartphones, connected vehicles, and drones. Performing efficient distributed statistical analysis on this data is crucial for real-time mobile computing applications. However, the constrained and dynamic nature of mobile environments exacerbates the privacy challenge: centralizing sensitive data for analysis risks severe privacy leaks, while existing privacy-preserving techniques often introduce excessive overhead or inaccuracies In this paper, we design, implement, and evaluate the first system that supports efficient and privacy-preserving distribution statistics analysis for mobile spatial data. First, we propose eSpat-B, which leverages two non-colluding servers and a newly designed improved...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Xuhao Ren · 方向: 系统安全
articles.summary: 随着移动计算发展，空间数据的高效隐私保护统计分析成为挑战。本文设计首个支持移动空间数据隐私保护分布统计分析的系统eSpat-B，利用两个非合谋服务器和新设计方法，在保证隐私的同时降低计算开销，适用于实时移动应用场景，有助于平衡数据效用与隐私风险。

articles.title: An Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Architecture for Cross-Institutional Collaborative RAG
articles.excerpt: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) empowers LLMs with external knowledge, making cross-institutional domain-specific knowledge base integration a highly promising deployment paradigm. Despite this potential, strict privacy regulations create severe "data silos" that obstruct such collaboration. Building federated RAG systems requires distributed inference, but the Transformer's self-attention mechanism fundamentally conflicts with this by mandating cross-node access to distributed Key-Value caches. To address this challenge, we present FedRAG, a high-throughput, privacy-preserving federated RAG framework. At its core is a novel Scrambled Distributed Attention protocol that utilizes numerically stable feature scrambling and token permutation. articles.meta: 第一作者: Chenxin Mao · 方向: 密码学协议
articles.summary: 检索增强生成需要集成跨机构知识，但隐私法规导致数据孤岛。本文提出FedRAG联邦RAG框架，其核心是Scrambled Distributed Attention协议，通过特征扰乱和token置换解耦注意力执行与数据访问，支持高吞吐隐私保护的分布式推理，为领域知识库安全协作提供解决方案。

articles.title: Ecosystem-Driven Privacy Exposure in Mobile Gaming Apps: A Configuration-Aware Empirical Analysis
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Mobile gaming apps increasingly rely on third-party Software Development Kits SDKs for advertising, analytics, attribution, and user engagement, potentially introducing privacy exposure beyond traditional permission based risks. Existing studies have largely focused on permissions or isolated tracking behaviors, providing only a partial understanding of privacy exposure in modern mobile ecosystems. This study presents a configuration aware empirical assessment of privacy exposure in Android mobile gaming apps by examining permissions, manifest level configurations, exported components, and SDK ecosystem complexity across children-oriented and general-audience games. A systematic static analysis was conducted on 41 widely deployed Android mobile gaming apps collected from the Google Play ecosystem. The analysis incorporated SDK categorisation and statistical evaluation using...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Bakheet Aljedaani · 方向: 软件安全
articles.summary: 移动游戏应用广泛依赖第三方SDK，可能引入超出传统权限的隐私风险。本文进行配置感知的实证分析，系统检查41款Android游戏应用的权限、清单配置、导出组件和SDK生态，评估儿童与普通游戏的隐私暴露情况，揭示了SDK复杂性对隐私的影响，为应用安全审查提供依据。

articles.title: Referential Security as a New Paradigm for AI Evaluations
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Security evaluations inherently depend on stable identifiers. Any finding, audit, or regulatory decision must remain attached to the specific artifact it pertains to. Continuously updated artificial intelligence systems violate this core assumption, with public model designations remaining static while underlying weights, prompts, retrieval mechanisms, misuse classifiers, inference settings, and serving infrastructures undergo unannounced modifications. Consequently, current evaluations frequently apply to superficial labels rather than identifiable and distinct systems. To resolve this, we propose referential security as a new paradigm for AI evaluation. The fundamental security question extends beyond whether a model is safe to whether subsequent parties can conclusively determine which system a specific safety claim addressed. articles.meta: 第一作者: Dan Ristea · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 当前AI评估依赖稳定标识符，但持续更新的系统破坏这一假设。本文提出Referential Security作为新评估范式，将核心问题从“模型是否安全”扩展到“能否确定安全声明针对的系统”，通过重新定义模型身份确保评估的可追溯性，适用于AI安全审计与监管场景。

articles.title: Heimdall: Formally Verified Automated Migration of Legacy eBPF Programs to Rust
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) programs are kernel extensions used for networking, observability, and security enforcement in the Linux kernel. articles.summary: eBPF程序存在源代码级bug，可能绕过内核验证器导致数据损坏或信息泄露。本文提出Heimdall，一个正式验证的自动迁移工具，将遗留eBPF程序迁移到Rust语言，通过形式化验证确保迁移后程序的安全性，提升了内核扩展的可靠性，适用于系统安全增强领域。

articles.title: Evo-Attacker: Memory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Tool Attacks on LLM-MAS
articles.excerpt: While Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-MAS) demonstrate remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks by orchestrating specialized agents and external tools, the implicit trust in tool outputs creates a critical attack surface. articles.summary: LLM多智能体系统隐式信任工具输出，存在安全攻击面。本文提出Evo-Attacker，将工具攻击建模为自进化记忆增强强化学习过程，通过动态攻击记忆和审慎推理自适应修改干预，并引入攻击流GRPO优化中间步骤，解决长 horizon 信用分配挑战，可用于AI安全测试与攻击模拟。

articles.title: KYA: A Framework-Agnostic Trust Layer for Autonomous Systems with Verifiable Provenance and Hierarchical Policy Composition
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Observability tells operators when an agent is slow. KYA tells operators when an agent is wrong, drifting, leaking, or quietly going rogue. articles.meta: 第一作者: Kolawole Quadri · 方向: 密码学协议
articles.summary: 自治系统需要信任和治理机制来检测异常行为。本文提出KYA，一个框架无关的开源信任层，包含可验证溯源、分层策略组合等五个原语，提供签名验证、信任评分和审计交互功能，帮助操作员监控代理的错误、漂移或异常，适用于多智能体系统安全治理。

articles.title: Decoupling Reentrancy Protection from Smart Contract Implementation Logic

articles.meta: 第一作者: Shashank Joshi · 方向: 系统安全
articles.summary: 研究问题：重入攻击对去中心化应用（DApps）构成持续威胁，现有检测和防护方法覆盖不全且缺乏鲁棒性。核心方法：提出 Sentinel，一种基于代理的解决方案，通过将重入逻辑集成到代理层，以类型无关的方式拦截所有调用到实现合约，从而缓解漏洞。可能应用：增强智能合约安全性，防止资金损失。

articles.title: Pre-Characterization of Electromagnetic Side-Channel Leakage Using Publicly Available Information: A Case Study on E-Voting Interfaces
articles.excerpt: Abstract:In this work, we study the interface of the Brazilian e-Voting Machine (BVM) in the context of electromagnetic side-channel threats commonly referred to as TEMPEST attacks. articles.meta: 第一作者: Leonardo Teodoro · 方向: 密码学协议
articles.summary: 研究问题：电子投票系统的电磁辐射可能泄露敏感信息，构成侧信道威胁。核心方法：利用公开信息模拟巴西电子投票机接口，使用软件定义无线电（SDRs）分析电磁发射，以识别独特的频谱特征。可能应用：提升选举系统安全性，防止通过电磁辐射的信息窃取。

articles.title: Security in the Fine-Tuning Lifecycle of Large Language Models: Threats, Defenses,Evaluation, and Future Directions
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Background: Fine-tuning is central to adapting pre-trained Large Language Models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but its reliance on training data, parameter updates, and reusable components opens entry points for attackers. Threats have evolved from data poisoning and weight tampering to agent manipulation and interface exploitation, yet existing reviews lack a unified framework spanning the full fine-tuning lifecycle. Objective: This paper presents a systematic survey of LLM fine-tuning security and establishes a lifecycle-based framework for comparing attacks and defenses, complemented by unified empirical evaluation. Methods: We divide attack and defense mechanisms into three phases by intervention timing: pre-tuning, during-tuning, and post-tuning. articles.meta: 第一作者: Wenjuan Li · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 研究问题：大型语言模型（LLM）微调过程存在多种安全威胁，如数据中毒和权重篡改。核心方法：系统综述攻击和防御机制，提出基于微调生命周期的框架（微调前、微调中、微调后），并提供统一评估方法。可能应用：指导安全微调实践，提升LLM部署的安全性。

articles.title: Securing High-Performance Data Transfers: Implementing AES Encryption in RDMA Systems
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) is a key enabler of high-performance systems, offering low latency, high throughput, and reduced CPU overhead by allowing direct memory-to-memory transfers between machines. However, its design bypasses traditional CPU-mediated security mechanisms, introducing critical vulnerabilities in untrusted environments. This work explores the integration of RDMA and AES-128 encryption to secure data transfers without compromising performance. We implement encryption directly within the data plane of a programmable Tofino switch using the P4 programming language. By offloading encryption from the CPU to the switch, our design preserves RDMA's performance benefits while addressing its security shortcomings. articles.meta: 第一作者: Erik Bångsbo · 方向: 密码学协议
articles.summary: 研究问题：远程直接内存访问（RDMA）系统绕过传统安全机制，在不受信任环境中存在漏洞。核心方法：在可编程 Tofino 交换机的数据平面中直接实现 AES-128 加密，将加密从 CPU 卸载到交换机。可能应用：保护高性能数据传输，适用于数据中心和云环境。

articles.title: MemMark: State-Evolution Attribution Watermarking for Agent Long-Term Memory Systems
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Memory-backed agents need provenance that can survive leaked or migrated snapshots, where logs, visible outputs, and trusted metadata may be absent. At each internal LLM call, MemMark samples among admissible candidates using keyed, distribution-preserving selection, and records cryptographic commitments with signed session anchors and reveal evidence. This makes attribution depend on reproducible backend behavior rather than mutable provenance fields. It also provides usable carrier capacity, with 1.16, 1.14, and 1.26 bits of mean entropy for update-target...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Haobo Zhang · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 研究问题：记忆支持的代理需要在快照泄露或迁移时进行归属验证，但现有元数据可能不可靠。核心方法：提出 MemMark，在内部LLM调用中嵌入基于密钥的选择，记录加密承诺和签名锚点，实现可重现的归属。可能应用：增强AI代理系统的安全性和审计能力。

articles.title: EnThM: Energy Theft Mitigation in Smart Grids using Hierarchical Verification of Metering Data
articles.excerpt: Abstract:The advent of digital technologies has revolutionized traditional power distribution networks, transforming them into smart grids that are more reliable, efficient, and sustainable. Despite these advancements, electricity theft remains a significant threat to the effective operation of large electrical networks. To address this issue, we propose EnThM, a lightweight and communication-efficient scheme for real-time mitigation of power theft in smart grid systems. Our approach uses the hierarchical structure of the smart grid infrastructure to verify the authenticity of the metering data at multiple levels of the power distribution network. Our work focuses primarily on issues related to cryptographic security. The verification process involves statistically modeling the cumulative averages of the power usage data and applying rule-based checks on the aggregated power...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Tapadyoti Banerjee · 方向: 网络安全
articles.summary: 研究问题：智能电网中的电力盗窃威胁网络有效运行，现有方案通信开销大。核心方法：提出 EnThM，利用智能电网的层次结构，在多级配电网络中验证计量数据的完整性，结合统计建模和规则检查。可能应用：实时缓解电力盗窃，提高电网安全性。

articles.title: APT-Agent: Automated Penetration Testing using Large Language Models
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Penetration testing is essential to securing modern web infrastructures, yet traditional manual methods struggle to keep pace with their scale and complexity. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for automating these tasks, but existing approaches face two persistent challenges: hallucination of technical entities and insufficient long-term contextual memory. To address these issues, we present APT-Agent, a fully automated LLM-driven penetration testing framework that systematically orchestrates reconnaissance, exploitation, and exfiltration. APT-Agent introduces a hybrid rectification module to recover hallucinated commands and a command-specific memory architecture to preserve operational context across multi-step attack sequences. We evaluate our APT-Agent on Metasploitable 2 against seven vulnerable services spanning web, database, and network protocols...
articles.meta: 第一作者: William Guanting Li · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 研究问题：传统手动渗透测试难以跟上网络规模和复杂性，现有LLM自动化方法面临幻觉和长期记忆不足问题。核心方法：引入 APT-Agent，一个完全自动化的LLM驱动框架，使用混合纠正模块和命令特定记忆架构。可能应用：自动化安全测试，提升Web基础设施的安全性。

articles.title: Memory-Induced Tool-Drift in LLM Agents
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Modern LLM agents combine long-term memory for personalization with tool-calling interfaces for taking actions in the world -- a combination underpinning contemporary production systems. We study a previously unexamined failure of this combination: when personality-driven biases stored in memory (cost-consciousness, impatience, risk tolerance, etc.) silently affect tool calls in contexts where they are not applicable. We call this memory-induced tool-drift and operationalize it through MEMDRIFT, a benchmark of 105 scenarios spanning five bias dimensions and seven professional domains, generated through an automated adversarial pipeline. Across seven frontier models -- including those with extended reasoning -- biased memories raise deflection scores (a judge-scored measure of parameter deviation from unbiased baselines) by up to $+3.6$ points on a 1--5 scale. Tool-drift...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Mahavir Dabas · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 研究问题：LLM代理中长期记忆的偏差可能无意中影响工具调用，导致性能下降。核心方法：定义记忆诱导的工具漂移，创建 MEMDRIFT 基准，涵盖多种偏差维度和专业领域，用于评估偏差影响。可能应用：评估和缓解代理系统中的偏差问题。

articles.title: SEED: Semi-supervised Continual MalwarE Detection for Tackling ConcEpt Drift on a BuDget
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Machine learning based malware detectors become obsolete over time due to concept drift in benign and malware applications. Recent methods rely on fully labeled data and use hierarchical contrastive loss (HCL) with active learning to improve robustness against drift by exploiting semantic structure in malware representations. However, obtaining labeled data in the security domain is difficult. Under partially labeled settings, HCL suffers significant performance degradation in detecting unseen malware, especially on datasets such as BODMAS where strong semantic structure may not exist. In this paper, we propose SEED, a semantic-structure-agnostic method for malware detection under limited supervision. SEED combines a tailored binary cross-entropy objective with semi-supervised continual learning and active learning. For partially labeled seen tasks, unlabeled samples are...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Suresh Kumar Amalapuram · 方向: 软件安全
articles.summary: 机器学习驱动的恶意软件检测器会因数据分布变化而失效，且获取标注数据成本高昂。本文提出 SEED 方法，该方法在有限标注数据下，将定制的交叉熵损失与半监督持续学习及主动学习相结合，旨在构建一个不依赖数据语义结构的、对概念漂移鲁棒的恶意软件检测系统。

articles.title: Reflect-Guard: Enhancing LLM Safeguards against Adversarial Prompts via Logical Self-Reflection
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Large language model (LLM) safety classifiers such as Llama Guard are effective at detecting overtly harmful prompts but remain vulnerable to adversarial jailbreak attacks that disguise malicious intent through role-play scenarios, fictional framing, and indirect requests. We present Reflect-Guard, a method that augments LLM-based safety classifiers with chain-of-thought self-reflection capabilities through parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Our approach distills analytical reasoning from GPT-4o-mini into structured reflection annotations, then trains Llama-Guard-3-8B via QLoRA to generate logical self-reflections before issuing safety verdicts. Using only 1000 training examples and updating just 0.5% of model parameters (~42M), Reflect-Guard achieves substantial improvements on two challenging benchmarks. On WildGuardTest, F1 score improves from 0.770 to 0.842 (+7.2 pp), with...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Lixing Lin · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 现有的大语言模型安全分类器易受通过角色扮演等方式伪装的对抗性提示攻击。Reflect-Guard 方法通过参数高效微调，为 LLM 安全分类器引入链式思考自省能力，使其能在给出安全判定前生成逻辑自省。仅使用少量训练样本和微调参数，该方法在挑战性基准测试中显著提升了检测性能。

articles.title: RouteScan: A Non-Intrusive Approach to Auditing MoE LLMs Safety via Expert Routing Telemetry
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become an increasingly important paradigm for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs). As MoE models are increasingly deployed in real-world services, safety auditing becomes necessary to verify whether these models produce or facilitate harmful behaviors during operation. However, existing content-based auditing methods typically require access to user prompts, model inputs, or generated outputs, potentially exposing sensitive user information and creating a fundamental tension between LLM safety and user privacy. On the other hand, we observe that, in MoE models, sparse expert routing maps different inputs to activate different expert-execution patterns, producing measurable footprints in low-level GPU execution telemetry. Inspired by this observation, we propose RouteScan, a non-intrusive auditing framework for detecting harmful...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Bo Lv · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 针对混合专家模型的安全审计通常需要访问用户数据，存在隐私泄露风险。本文观察到专家路由模式会在 GPU 执行遥测中留下踪迹，并据此提出 RouteScan 框架。该框架通过分析底层 GPU 遥测数据来检测有害行为，无需访问模型输入输出，为审计 MoE 模型的安全性提供了一种非侵入式途径。

articles.title: CyberMaskQA: A Privacy-Aware Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Cybersecurity Question Answering
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to cybersecurity question answering (QA) for critical tasks such as incident response and vulnerability analysis. However, real-world operational contexts, including system logs and network configurations, inherently contain sensitive identifiers, e.g., IP addresses, host names, and user accounts. Processing this data with cloud-based models is often unsafe or infeasible in regulated environments. Furthermore, progress in privacy-preserving QA is hindered by the lack of annotated, context-rich datasets capable of jointly evaluating operational reasoning and privacy preservation. To address this gap, we introduce CYBERMASKQA, a privacy-aware QA benchmark covering key security domains. Unlike existing benchmarks that primarily test factual knowledge, CYBERMASKQA grounds questions in realistic organizational contexts with...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Matilda Gaddi · 方向: 系统安全
articles.summary: 将大语言模型应用于网络安全问答时，常涉及敏感数据处理，且缺乏评估隐私保护能力的基准。本文引入 CyberMaskQA 基准测试，其问题根植于真实的组织上下文，覆盖关键安全领域，旨在同时评估模型在网络安全领域的推理能力与隐私保护水平。

articles.title: CALIBURN: A Regime-Sensitivity Study of Operationally Calibrated Streaming Intrusion Detection
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Streaming network intrusion detection systems must process flows continuously while keeping memory bounded, but most current methods leave alerting threshold selection as a post-hoc tuning problem poorly suited to production. Operators need alerting behaviour specifiable before deployment using inputs such as false-negative cost, false-positive cost, and alerting budget. articles.meta: 第一作者: Michel A. Youssef · 方向: 网络安全
articles.summary: 流式网络入侵检测系统的告警阈值选择通常依赖事后调参。本文提出 CALIBURN，一个五组件流式告警管道。它整合了变点检测、概率校准、成本敏感决策、共形风险控制等技术，允许运营人员在部署前依据误报成本、告警预算等输入预先设定告警行为。

articles.title: CyBOKClaw: Human-in-the-Loop CyBOK Mapping for Cybersecurity Curriculum
articles.excerpt: Abstract:This paper presents CyBOKClaw, an interpretable human-in-the-loop retrieval framework for mapping cybersecurity keywords or phrases (KWoPs) to the Cyber Security Body of Knowledge (CyBOK). Rather than treating the task as strict exact classification, the framework is designed as a top-k candidate generator for expert review. It combines query normalization, curated term expansion, concept-level boosts, topic-description enrichment, and domain-sensitive ranking rules. Because educational KWoPs are often broad, ambiguous, and only approximately aligned with CyBOK terminology, strict exact matching provides only a partial account of practical utility. articles.meta: 第一作者: Yan Lin Aung · 方向: 安全研究
articles.summary: 将网络安全关键词映射到标准知识体（CyBOK）是一项有挑战的任务。本文提出 CyBOKClaw，一个可解释的人机交互检索框架。它结合查询规范化、术语扩展、主题描述富集和领域敏感排序等技术，旨在为专家审阅生成 top-k 候选映射，而非严格的精确分类。

articles.title: Demystifying the Mythos or Disrupting Bugonomics? From Zero-Day Asymmetry to Defender Remediation Throughput
articles.excerpt: Recent demonstrations of large language models producing candidate and confirmed vulnerabilities in production software have renewed the narrative that AI will reshape offensive and defensive security. Headlines emphasize capability; they rarely interrogate costs and incentives. This paper examines LLM-driven vulnerability discovery through a bugonomics lens: the operational economics of producing, proving, prioritizing, and fixing security-relevant defects. Historically, the most visible high-end bugonomics was offense-priced because production-grade zero-days and exploit chains were expensive specialist outputs for governments, brokers, and offensive vendors. articles.meta: 第一作者: Alfredo Pesoli · 方向: 软件安全
articles.summary: 大语言模型驱动的漏洞发现能力引发了对攻防安全格局变化的讨论。本文从“漏洞经济学”视角审视该现象，分析 LLM 如何改变漏洞生产、证明、优先排序和修复的操作经济学，探讨其在改变攻击方与防御方经济成本结构方面可能带来的影响。

articles.title: Analyzing Concentration, Temporal Routines and Targeting in Public Ransomware Leak Site Data
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Ransomware has grown to become one of the most damaging types of cybercrime, affecting private and public organizations in any sector. While early types of ransomware targeted many victims via automated attacks, ransomware groups have started to specifically target organizations and companies in the expectation of receiving larger ransoms. To increase the pressure on victims, most groups host so-called data leak sites, where information about their victims is made public. The shift towards 'human-operated' ransomware together with easily accessible behavioral traces available from data leak sites makes research investigating operational regularities of ransomware groups of interest. articles.meta: 第一作者: Lea Müller · 方向: 安全研究
articles.summary: 现代勒索软件组织常通过数据泄露网站施压受害者。本文基于超过 27000 条泄露网站帖子数据，分析勒索软件群体的受害者集中度、时间规律和目标选择等运营模式，旨在揭示这些网络犯罪群体的可观察行为特征与规律。

articles.title: Ellipsoid Control: A White-list Jailbreak Defense via Benign Latent Modeling
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Representation engineering (RepE) defenses have shown strong robustness against jailbreak attacks on large language models (LLMs). However, these methods fundamentally rely on black-list supervision: they learn jailbreak-to-refusal activation transformations from harmful or jailbreak data that are inherently incomplete and continuously evolving. Hence, the performance of RepE-based defenses becomes tightly coupled to the quality and coverage of collected harmful samples, leaving models vulnerable to unseen attacks. This reliance also obscures the distinction between defenses that fit known harmful distributions and defenses that protect a benign latent region without estimating the harmful distribution. articles.meta: 第一作者: Luoyu Chen · 方向: 安全研究
articles.summary: 针对大语言模型越狱攻击，现有防御方法多依赖黑名单监督，其性能受限于有害数据样本的覆盖。本文提出一种白名单视角的防御方法「椭球控制」，通过利用丰富且易获取的良性数据，对模型的良性潜在区域进行建模。该方法旨在仅基于良性数据的分布，引导模型在面对任意输入时触发拒绝行为，从而不依赖有害样本即可实现更鲁棒、对未见攻击具有更好泛化能力的防御。

articles.title: Routing Cybersecurity Awareness Training by FFM Personality Trait: A Quasi-Experimental Evaluation
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Cybersecurity awareness training has historically adopted a one-size-fits-all approach, despite established individual differences in how users process and retain security information. Personality has been proposed as one axis along which training content might be tailored; yet no prior study has implemented and empirically evaluated a complete personality-conditional system end-to-end. This paper reports the design, implementation, and quasi-experimental evaluation of \emph{TailoredSec}, a mobile cybersecurity awareness application that routes training content based on a user's dominant Five-Factor Model (FFM) personality trait, as measured by the ten-item Big Five Inventory (BFI-10). articles.meta: 第一作者: Glory Okwata · 方向: 系统安全
articles.summary: 传统网络安全意识培训采用「一刀切」模式，忽略了用户个性差异。本研究设计并实现了移动应用TailoredSec，该系统基于用户的五大人格特质（FFM）来个性化推送培训内容。通过一项包含74名成年人的准实验评估，比较了传统视频培训与人格条件化培训的效果。研究旨在探索基于人格特质的定制化培训路径，以提升用户对安全信息的处理和记忆效果。

articles.title: AI-Driven Adaptive Adversaries and the Erosion of Cryptographic Trust in Public Key Systems
articles.excerpt: This paper examines the erosion of Public Key Cryptography (PKC) security under adaptive adversarial optimisation driven by artificial intelligence. The problem addressed is the growing mismatch between algorithm-centric cryptographic security models and operational attack realities, where adversaries exploit implementation-level observability rather than breaking cryptographic primitives.
articles.meta: 第一作者: Petar Radanliev · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 本文探讨了由人工智能驱动的自适应攻击者如何侵蚀公钥密码系统的安全性。研究指出，传统的以算法为中心的密码安全模型与现实攻击存在脱节。攻击者越来越多地利用密码实现层面的可观测性漏洞，而非直接破解密码原语。论文分析了AI驱动的对抗性优化对密码学信任基础构成的威胁，强调了安全模型需从理论算法向对抗真实世界实施攻击转移的必要性。

articles.title: Steering Beyond the Support: Adversarial Training on Unsupervised Jailbroken Activation Simulation
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Jailbreak prompts can trigger harmful completions on aligned LLMs, In accordance, safety steering has been proposed: test-time activation interventions that steer jailbreak activations to trigger refusal while preserving benign utility. articles.meta: 第一作者: Luoyu Chen · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 现有的大语言模型安全转向方法依赖于有监督的越狱数据，难以应对未见过的、分布外的越狱攻击。本文提出了一种基于无监督潜在方向发现的双层对抗性训练框架，用于零样本越狱防御。核心是在内层步骤中，通过从拒绝状态的有害请求激活点进行外推，来无监督地模拟多样化的「越狱激活」，从而扩大对真实越狱攻击的覆盖范围，提升模型对未见攻击的鲁棒性。

articles.title: Poisoning the Watchtower: Prompt Injection Attacks Against LLM-Augmented Security Operations Through Adversarial Log Content
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as analyst assistants in security operations centers (SOCs), where they ingest log and alert data to produce triage labels, incident summaries, or remediation advice. articles.meta: 第一作者: Rohan Pandey · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 大语言模型正被用作安全运维中心的分析助手，用于处理日志和告警数据。然而，许多日志字段可由攻击者控制，这为提示注入攻击创造了条件，本文称之为「日志基底提示注入」。研究提出了一个四类攻击分类法（直接覆盖、人格劫持、上下文操纵、混淆载荷），并评估了多种攻击策略与防御措施。研究发现，直接覆盖攻击无效，但上下文操纵和混淆载荷攻击能有效干扰LLM的分析结果。

articles.title: Five Queries Are Enough: Query-Efficient and Surrogate-Free Membership Inference Attacks on RAG via Entailment

articles.summary: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统在输出中可能泄露检索语料库中特定文档的存在信息，引发成员推断隐私风险。现有攻击方法常依赖模板化查询或需要大量高成本查询。本文提出MEntA攻击，一种高效的成员推断攻击方法。它利用自然语言蕴涵关系来最大化每次查询获得的信息量，旨在以有限的查询预算，发起无需替代模型、隐蔽且对防御机制鲁棒的攻击。

articles.title: Reframing LLM Agent Security as an Agent-Human Interaction Problem
articles.excerpt: Abstract:We argue that LLM agent security is fundamentally an agent-human interaction (AHI) problem, not a purely algorithmic one. articles.meta: 第一作者: Peiran Wang · 方向: AI 安全

articles.title: Enhancing Reliability in LLM-Based Secure Code Generation

articles.meta: 第一作者: Mohammed F. Kharma · 方向: 软件安全
articles.summary: 大语言模型在代码生成中的安全性表现不一致。本文提出了缓解感知的思维链框架，在推理过程中内嵌特定常见弱点枚举的缓解指南和语言感知的安全防护措施。评估显示，该框架能显著减少LLM在三种编程语言上生成代码的漏洞数量。研究旨在通过改进提示工程方法，增强LLM代码生成功能的可靠性，减少反复出现的脆弱性。

articles.title: An Empirical Evaluation of LLM-Generated Code Security Across Prompting Methods
articles.excerpt: Abstract:The growing use of Large Language Models (LLMs) for automated code generation has enhanced software development efficiency, but often at the cost of security. Generated code frequently overlooks critical concerns, leaving it vulnerable to issues such as weak encryption and improper input validation. To investigate this problem, we present a comprehensive empirical evaluation of the security quality of LLM-generated code across five LLMs and four programming languages (Java, C++, C, and Python), examining the impact of multiple prompt engineering methods. We introduce a weaknesses-aware zero-shot chain-of-thought (WA-0CoT) prompting strategy that enriches prompts with security context using CWE mappings to guide model reasoning. Our empirical analysis, supported by chi-square tests, finds no statistically significant reductions in vulnerability frequency or density across...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Mohammed Kharma · 方向: 密码学协议
articles.summary: 该研究对五种大语言模型（LLM）在四种编程语言中生成代码的安全性进行了实证评估。论文探讨了不同提示工程方法对生成代码安全的影响，并提出了一种名为「弱点感知零样本思维链」的提示策略，该策略利用CWE映射为模型推理提供安全上下文。研究发现，这些方法并未显著降低生成代码中的漏洞频率或密度。

articles.title: Concept Drift Adaptation Using Self-Supervised and Reinforcement Learning In Android Malware Detection
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Android malware detectors often degrade after deployment because of concept drift, while full retraining at each maintenance step is costly. We propose a chronological adaptive maintenance framework that models deployment-time maintenance as a sequential decision problem. The framework learns a stable latent representation through self-supervised learning during initialization, freezes the encoder, measures latent drift in the fixed representation space, and performs lightweight downstream adaptation using a trainable adapter and classification head. A proximal policy optimization controller selects low-cost maintenance actions based on the detector state, including current utility, retention on a fixed memory set, latent drift indicators, and update cost. We evaluate the framework under a causal deployment-style protocol on emulator and real Android malware datasets with...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Ahmed Sabbah · 方向: 密码学协议
articles.summary: 针对Android恶意软件检测器在部署后因概念漂移而性能下降的问题，本文提出了一种基于时序的自适应维护框架。该框架将部署时的维护建模为序列决策问题，通过自监督学习学习稳定的潜在表示，并利用强化学习控制器根据检测器状态选择低成本的维护动作，以实现高效的持续适应。

articles.title: Attested Tool-Server Admission: A Security Extension to the Model Context Protocol
articles.excerpt: Abstract:The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes how a large-language-model (LLM) agent and an external tool server exchange messages, but not trust: a host reads a server's self-declared tool list and dispatches calls, with no notion of which servers it may use, at what sensitivity, or which of a server's tools are in bounds. This work grew out of a concrete need -- letting the Enclawed agent use Google's externally-operated MCP servers (Gmail, Calendar, Drive) safely, admitting the server and bounding the tools it may drive, without changing MCP or Enclawed's own tool application-programming interface (API). The mechanism we built, mcp-attested (shipped in both the open enclawed-oss distribution and the enclaved flavor), generalizes: the gap that makes an unmediated third-party connection unsafe for one user makes a regulated deployment impossible to accredit. We close it with...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Alfredo Metere · 方向: 密码学协议
articles.summary: 本文针对模型上下文协议（MCP）中缺乏信任机制的问题，提出了一种名为「mcp-attested」的安全扩展。该机制旨在解决大语言模型智能体在连接外部工具服务器时无法验证其可信性、也无法限制其可用工具范围的安全缺口。它通过引入基于证据的准入控制，允许智能体安全地使用第三方服务器，而无需修改MCP本身。

articles.title: Deep-Research Agents Can Be Poisoned via User-Generated Content
articles.excerpt: Deep-research agents, i.e., systems that rely on multi-agent pipelines to iteratively retrieve, synthesize, and cite Web content in order to produce structured reports, are rapidly replacing traditional search for both routine and complex information needs. These agents issue many related queries during a single research session. We show that for many common search topics, they repeatedly retrieve the same user-generated content (UGC) pages from platforms such as Reddit and Wikipedia. Next, we argue that this retrieval overlap creates a concentrated attack surface: an adversary who appends a short, crafted text to a single, frequently retrieved UGC page can cause the agent to cite attacker-chosen content and promote attacker-chosen entities across many related queries. We evaluate this attack on three representative deep-research systems (STORM, Co-STORM, and OmniThink) across multiple...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Tingwei Zhang · 方向: 网络安全
articles.summary: 该论文揭示了依赖多智能体管道进行网络内容检索和综合的「深度研究智能体」存在的安全风险。研究指出，这类智能体在单次研究会话中常重复检索特定用户生成内容页面，攻击者可通过向这些高频检索页面注入精心构造的短文本，来影响智能体在多个相关查询中的输出，实现对报告内容的操纵。

articles.title: Unlocking Apple's Private Cloud Compute: An Analysis of Privacy-Preserving Artificial Intelligence
articles.excerpt: Many existing Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions on mobile devices rely on an extensive collection of sensitive data, raising privacy concerns and often requiring storage for both context and model improvement. Apple's Private Cloud Compute (PCC) aims to address this by emphasizing mobile device integration and a privacy-first design. The central claim of PCC is that it does not store any user data and that user input and user accounts are unlinkable. While most of the PCC system specifications are public, compiled binaries add a layer of opaqueness. There are no reproducible builds, and there are no symbols within those binaries, creating potential discrepancies between the specification and what is shipped to the user. Additionally, the underlying models and interfaces for querying PCC are not openly accessible, limiting academic evaluation of model properties, such as accuracy...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Yannik Dittmar · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 本文对苹果公司「私有云计算」系统进行了安全性分析。PCC旨在通过隐私优先设计保护用户数据。然而，作者指出，由于系统二进制文件缺乏可重现构建和符号，其实际实现与公开规范可能存在不一致。此外，底层模型和查询接口未公开，限制了学术界对其准确性等模型属性进行独立评估的能力。

articles.title: FALCON-C: Flow-based Analysis and Labeling for Connected Vehicular Network Cybersecurity
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Along with the recent rise in popularity of Electric Vehicles (EVs), Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE) has emerged as a new target for cyber attacks. Therefore, ensuring the security and integrity of network communication between EVSE components and vehicular clients is a significant challenge that must be addressed. To this end, this paper proposes a Flow-based Analysis and Labeling for COnnected vehicular Network Cybersecurity (FALCON-C) framework. The FALCON-C framework leverages an autoencoder for anomaly detection and is trained on a small number of benign flows from the CICEVSE2024 dataset. The model's objective is to model benign flow behavior and identify malicious flows by detecting statistically different reconstruction error profiles. The results demonstrate that the model can successfully identify malicious flows, achieving 100% accuracy. Initially, some...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Joshua Bean · 方向: 网络安全
articles.summary: 为应对电动汽车充电设备日益增长的网络安全挑战，本文提出了FALCON-C框架。该框架利用基于自编码器的异常检测模型，通过学习正常网络流量的行为模式来识别恶意流量。实验表明，该模型在特定数据集上能够成功识别恶意流，取得了很高的准确率。

articles.title: Cybersecurity of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure: Recent Advances, Open Challenges, and Future Directions
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Electric Vehicles (EVs) have emerged as significant disruptors in the transportation sector over the past decade. Their growing popularity and adoption are accompanied by capital expenditures to deploy charging infrastructure. EV charging infrastructure sits at the intersection of the power grid, the network, and the vehicular client, creating an attractive surface for cyberattacks. Many machine learning-based cybersecurity countermeasures have been developed using various public and private datasets. These countermeasures, often intrusion detection systems, are limited in performance by the quality and expressivity of the training data. This work explores the most common datasets and modeling methods, identifies key limitations and open challenges, and proposes future directions to continue catalyzing innovation in the field. By addressing these data limitations, intrusion...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Joshua Bean · 方向: AI 安全
articles.summary: 本文是一篇关于电动汽车充电基础设施网络安全的综述。文章指出，充电设施处于电网、网络和车辆的交汇点，是网络攻击的潜在目标。论文回顾了基于机器学习的防御措施（如入侵检测系统），总结了现有公开和私有数据集的局限性，识别了该领域的关键开放挑战，并提出了未来的研究方向。

articles.title: When the Manual Lies: A Realistic Benchmark to Evaluate MCP Poisoning Attacks for LLM Agents
articles.excerpt: Abstract:The rise of tool-using Large Language Model (LLM) agents, standardized by protocols like the Model Context Protocol (MCP), has unlocked unprecedented autonomous execution capabilities for LLM Agents by integrating external open-domain knowledge and tools. However, this interoperability introduces a covert attack surface targeting the agent's cognitive planning layer. This paper systematically investigates Tool Description Poisoning (TDP), a novel semantic attack. In TDP, malicious instructions are not embedded in a tool's executable code, but rather covertly injected into its descriptive metadata, the very "manual" an agent relies on for secure planning and decision-making. To rigorously and systematically evaluate this emerging threat, we introduce the MCP-TDP Security Benchmark. This high-fidelity sandbox environment comprises 32 realistic, real-world test cases spanning 6...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Shi Liu · 方向: 密码学协议
articles.summary: 本文系统研究了针对工具型大语言模型智能体的「工具描述投毒」攻击。在此类攻击中，恶意指令被隐蔽地注入到工具的描述性元数据中，而非可执行代码内，从而误导依赖该描述进行规划的智能体。为评估这一威胁，作者构建了一个包含多个真实世界测试用例的高保真沙盒基准测试平台。

articles.title: Microbenchmarking Cloud Cryptographic Workloads for Privacy-Preserving Healthcare IoT
articles.excerpt: Cryptographic operations are an essential component of cloud security architectures; their comprehensive performance characterization across different cloud services, hardware architectures, and programming language implementations remains unknown. Specifically, healthcare IoT devices are highly vulnerable and frequently targeted, yet the cryptographic performance trade offs in their cloud security architectures remain poorly understood. This research presents an extensive microbenchmark study evaluating the performance of core cryptographic workloads, including SHA HMAC generation, AES encryption, decryption, Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) signature generation and verification, and RSA encryption, decryption, across Function as a Service (FaaS) integrated with Key Management Services (KMS) from Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure. We evaluate FaaS platforms using Elastic...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Jeremiah L. Webb · 方向: 密码学协议
articles.summary: 该研究关注医疗物联网云安全架构中加密操作的性能特性未知的问题。核心方法是在AWS和Azure的FaaS平台上，对SHA HMAC、AES、ECC、RSA等加密工作负载进行全面微基准测试。研究意义在于为优化隐私保护的医疗物联网系统提供性能数据参考。

articles.title: Verifiable Secure Aggregation via Dual Servers with Linear Tags in Federated Learning
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training by aggregating local updates without requiring raw data sharing. However, prior studies have shown that servers can exploit gradient inversion to compromise user privacy or manipulate aggregation results, undermining the utility of the global model. To address these concerns, we propose a secure and verifiable aggregation scheme with lightweight cryptographic primitives for FL. Our method leverages pseudo-random functions (PRFs) and a non-colluding dual-server architecture to achieve secure aggregation with mutual server verification, while maintaining communication overhead comparable to plaintext aggregation and a constant verification tag size. articles.meta: 第一作者: Yufei Zhou · 方向: 隐私保护
articles.summary: 针对联邦学习中服务器可能侵犯隐私或操纵聚合结果的问题，本文提出一种安全可验证聚合方案。核心方法是利用伪随机函数和非共谋双服务器架构，实现轻量级加密和验证。该方案能保护用户隐私，实现端到端安全聚合，并减少通信开销。

articles.title: HumanFlow -- Diffusion-Driven MAV Navigation Among Humans via Tightly-Coupled Motion Tracking, Forecasting, and Control
articles.excerpt: Robust and accurate perception of humans in their 3D scene context is essential for integrating robots into everyday environments. Existing approaches, however, often fail to predict plausible and accurate human motion estimates that are consistent with the surrounding scene, especially in the presence of heavy occlusions or partial visibility. This can limit both safety and efficiency for robotic operations. We introduce HumanFlow, a latent diffusion model that unifies human motion tracking and forecasting, conditioned on the 3D scene context. We show that our human motion model produces smooth and accurate predictions under challenging conditions, including heavy occlusions, and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in tracking accuracy while being significantly more efficient. Furthermore, we show how HumanFlow's latent space can be tightly coupled with control by conditioning a...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Simon Schaefer · 方向: 导航与运动 · 来源: cs.RO
articles.summary: 为解决机器人在人类环境中运动感知和预测不准确的问题，本文引入HumanFlow。该核心方法是一个潜在扩散模型，统一人类运动跟踪和预测，并基于3D场景上下文进行条件化。应用可提升微空中车辆在人类环境中的导航安全与效率。

articles.title: ParkingWorld: End-to-End Autonomous Parking Reinforcement Learning from Corrective Experience in 3DGS Simulation
articles.excerpt: Autonomous parking demands precise low-speed maneuvering within narrow, cluttered, and highly constrained environments, where vehicles must navigate tight spaces while avoiding static obstacles and complex geometric boundaries. Unlike imitation learning, which typically requires massive volumes of high-quality expert demonstrations to converge to a stable policy and often suffers from limited generalization to unseen scenarios, traditional reinforcement learning (RL) methods face persistent challenges including excessive training overhead, inefficient exploration, and even failure to learn viable parking strategies in challenging settings. To address these limitations, this paper presents a correction-in-the-loop sample-efficient reinforcement learning (CIL-SERL) framework for end-to-end autonomous parking, which is entirely trained in a photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)...
articles.meta: 第一作者: Zhengcheng Yu · 方向: 模仿学习 · 来源: cs.RO
articles.summary: 自动驾驶停车在狭窄环境中面临精确操纵挑战，传统强化学习或模仿学习有局限性。本文提出纠正循环样本高效强化学习（CIL-SERL）框架，在3D高斯溅射模拟中训练。该方法旨在提高停车策略的学习效率和泛化能力，减少对专家演示的依赖。

articles.title: Micro-Swarm Locomotion Optimization in Dynamic Flow using Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
articles.excerpt: Coordinating micro-robotic swarms in physiologically realistic, time-dependent fluid environments remains an unsolved challenge for biomedical and environmental applications. We present a hybrid Computational Fluid Dynamics - Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning framework that directly couples a high-fidelity incompressible Navier-Stokes solver with decentralized proximal policy optimization to learn physically consistent swarm control strategies in oscillatory flow. Sixteen magnetically actuated micro-robots navigate a pulsatile arterial waveform, simultaneously optimizing upstream progression, energy conservation, and motion smoothness, reconciled using PCGrad surgery.
